verses.fa-inna-dina-rasulillahi-fihi-lana-c1-v1: faʾinna dīna rasūli llāhi fīhi lanā ḥallu l-mashākili dunyāhā waʾukhrāhā
verses.fa-inna-dina-rasulillahi-fihi-lana-c1-v2: kānat najāʾibuhu tazrī bisurʿatihā sayra ṣ-ṣawārīkhi ʾadnāhā waʾaqṣāhā
verses.fa-inna-dina-rasulillahi-fihi-lana-c1-v3: hadhī bibukratihā hadhī biḥḥaratihā hadhī biḥumratihā hadhī biwusṭāhā
verses.fa-inna-dina-rasulillahi-fihi-lana-c1-v4: hadhī biẓulmatihā ʾidh yaskunūna lahā ʾakrim biẓulmatihā ʾakrim bisuknāhā
verses.fa-inna-dina-rasulillahi-fihi-lana-c1-v5: waṣ-ṣawmu dhikrā liʾayyāmi l-qubūri lahum wafī l-qubūri lahum ʾahlu bizulfāhā
verses.fa-inna-dina-rasulillahi-fihi-lana-c1-v6: wal-ḥajju ṣūratu yawmi d-dīni ʾinna lahum fī ḥajjihim ʾāyata jallat bimaʿnāhā
verses.fa-inna-dina-rasulillahi-fihi-lana-c1-v7: wājʿal zakātaka rūḥā min musāhamahi ʾinna z-zakāta laʾawlahā waʾazkāhā
verses.fa-inna-dina-rasulillahi-fihi-lana-c1-v8: wafī n-najāʾibi lil-ʾakhlaqi tanẓimahu wafī ṣ-ṣiyāmi linafsi l-marʾi ʾaghnāhā
verses.fa-inna-dina-rasulillahi-fihi-lana-c1-v9: waqabla dhalika sirru min shahādatihi ʾinna sh-shahādata ʾimḍāʾu lijulahā
verses.fa-inna-dina-rasulillahi-fihi-lana-c1-v1: llāhu ʾakbaru wal-ʾislamu millatuhu wal-muṣṭafā min jamīʿi l-khalqi ʾatqāhā
